title: Momoi Airi — Pro Give And Take〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Neighborhood
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so glad I ran into you on my way to the MORE MORE HOUSE, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You do still tend to get lost.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I know how to get there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I turn where the yellow sign is after leaving the station. Then, when I reach the intersection, I turn towards the construction site...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They finished doing construction there last week.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I had a feeling...
Now I'm really glad that we ran into each other.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially since we're doing a stream today, and we absolutely can't be late for it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right...
I hope everyone enjoys our MORE MORE Study Session.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll be studying for a very long time, so I'm a little worried that our viewers are going to get bored of watching, or get tired...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry. We've got little game and chat breaks planned so that doesn't happen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's aim for a fun, and productive, study session with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're the seniors, so we need to set a good example.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why do you look so puzzled?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're a year ahead of Minori and Haruka, remember? We don't want to embarrass ourselves when it comes to school stuff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we need to be able to answer any questions they ask right away.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Does that mean you know what Minori and Haruka have been studying lately?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I do! This past week, on top of my usual studying, I spent some time flipping through my textbooks and notes from last year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But to be fair, Haruka's pretty sharp, so I'm not sure how much teaching we'll actually need to do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We can always count on you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, I might ask for your help too, if I get stuck somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We're in the same year!
Figure it out yourself!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We got all those study guides and reference materials together just for this day, remember?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, we had our own study session together to make sure that we're able to share some good tips and tricks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess if we really can't figure something out, then we can always ask our fans...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: After all, this is meant to be a group study session including all of them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
All of us teaching each other as a big group does sound like fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Being the seniors here does mean more pressure on us...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But let's make this stream fun for everyone!
Several dozen minutes later
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: We're back!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry. I can't help but treat this house like our new home...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Welcome home, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Welcome home, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't encourage us.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually, Minori and Haruka have both done the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-Saito?!
Don't sell us out like that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. So everyone does it!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, enough goofing. Let's get started with our stream meeting!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Good luck, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I took the liberty of putting some food in the fridge since I knew you'd be doing a long stream today.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Why don't you all have some during your meeting?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you, Saito!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's munch on that while we talk about today's stream!
